statement: The independent secondary wired XUSB reference identifies a vendor-specific controller USB interface rather than generic HID; community-compatible output message formats additionally documented by Linux and SDL consumers are wired rumble 8-byte 00 08 00 <left> <right> 00 00 00 and LED 3-byte 01 03 <mode>, but no independent physical-device output capture is available.

applicability.revision: pinned community Free60 ab1fe19, protoR2 4c0d062, x360w a8ac630; Linux 4056b3c; SDL 535d80b and 829a65d; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: Independent pinned USB Host Shield wired XUSB host implementation (XBOXUSB.cpp setLedRaw/setRumbleOn) creates the exact output bytes; kernel xpad.c 1569-1579,1682-1689 and SDL 97-107,199-209 corroborate. This is cross-implementation source support for a *device-side expected input command*, not physical actuation capture. protoR2 alone does not list output bytes.
